about_the_game:
Gruniożerca Trilogy is a remastered compilation of three independently developed retro puzzle games that originally launched on the NES. Take control of Grunio – a hungry pig on a mission – and dive into creative challenges packed with charm, humor, and pixel-perfect nostalgia.

Originally created by Łukasz "dizzy9" Kur and M-Tee, the games have now been faithfully brought to modern platforms by Take IT Studio!, preserving their distinct style while ensuring smooth performance on today's systems.

Whether you're new to the world of Grunio or a long-time fan, this trilogy offers a delightful journey through the golden age of 8-bit fun.

Includes:

  • Gruniożerca – classic puzzling with a tasty twist

  • Gruniożerca 2 – more challenges, more food, more Grunio

  • Gruniożerca 3: The Great Cavy Clean-Up! – brand new mechanics and outlandish scenarios

Features:

  • 8-bit inspired visuals and music

  • Three distinct gameplay styles in one package

  • Retro vibes with modern polish

  • A lovable pig hero like no other

  • Mlem!

The demo lets you experience the entire first game, along with a few early levels from the second and third installments. Full version of the game contains complete three Gruniożerca games!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 / AMD FX-6300
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX10 (shader model 4.0) capabilities
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Gruniożerca Trilogy is a collection of three unique puzzle games starring Grunio – a food-loving pig with a big heart (and an even bigger appetite)! Retro visuals, quirky mechanics, and absurd humor now on modern platforms!
